data.body:
[P2] Preserve serialization failures that are not Error objects

An input getter or `toJSON` can throw any JavaScript value. For `{ toJSON() { throw null; } }`, reading `.message` throws another TypeError before the wrapper is constructed. Both `microvm` and `vm.invoke` consequently lose the operation name and original `cause`; thrown strings produce an `undefined` detail. Normalize the caught value before constructing the wrapper, for example with `error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)`, retain `{ cause: error }`, and cover null, undefined, and string exceptions in tests.
